question: Should QQBot keep `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` as a supported data-directory override, or should the diagnostic stop recommending it now that runtime state moved to plugin SQLite KV?
rationale: The current diagnostic advertises the env var, but implementing it adds an env-controlled storage root and touches compatibility/security-sensitive path behavior.

options.title: Support validated override
options.body: Honor a trimmed, normalized, safe `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` in the QQBot data helper, update docs/tests, and require real diagnostic proof before merge.

options.title: Retire the env hint
options.body: Remove or replace the `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` diagnostic guidance and close the linked implementation PR as not planned for this storage path.

recommendation.title: Support validated override
recommendation.body: Honor a trimmed, normalized, safe `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` in the QQBot data helper, update docs/tests, and require real diagnostic proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent QQBot SQLite migration work makes this the best available owner for the data-root contract decision.
